subject: NimbleCare: SIG kickoff and scoped evidence matrix (post-demo clarifications)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: NimbleCare: SIG kickoff and scoped evidence matrix (post-demo clarifications)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation and really appreciate the detail on your use case. Per our talk, next step on the security side is to initiate the vendor questionnaire work so your security team can validate controls and we can map any gaps before a production rollout. To keep things efficient, we're starting with a SIG/CAIQ prefill and can also support a short custom form if needed.

Quick clarifying questions to help scope the evidence matrix (answers will speed the prefill):

- SOC 2 status: do you have a SOC 2 Type II report we can reference? If so, when was the audit period (month/year)?
- HIPAA: is NimbleCare considered a covered entity/BAA scope for this integration? Will you require Redwood to sign a BAA?
- Data residency & hosting: which cloud region(s) will your production traffic originate from (e.g., us-east-1)?
- PHI: will the integration send PHI (patient names, MRNs, clinical notes) to Redwood endpoints? If yes, approximate daily volume / QPS would be helpful.
- Retention: desired retention period for request/response logs and any PII/PHI (if applicable).
- Evidence lead: who should we send evidence requests to (name + email)?
- Timeline: target date for vendor security sign-off / go-live.

I've attached a blank prefill template (redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx) that maps typical SIG fields to the common evidence artifacts — if you can populate the short items and share any existing reports, we can return a prefilled CAIQ within 3 business days.

Proposed SIG kickoff windows: Tue Aug 24 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed Aug 25 1:00–1:45 PT. Please let me know which works or propose another slot.

Thanks — copying our SE (Avery) and our onboarding lead (Lauren) so they're looped for technical evidence and schedule.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Attachment: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, stub)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblecare.com>

Cc: NimbleCare Security <security@nimblecare.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCare: SIG kickoff and scoped evidence matrix (post-demo clarifications)

Hi Marcus —

Great to meet earlier — appreciate the clear next steps. Answers below: 

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report (audit period ended 2025-11). I can share the PDF and a short control summary.
- HIPAA: NimbleCare is a covered entity; we will require a BAA before production. We're currently finalizing our BAA process and expect to have internal sign-off in Q4 2026.
- Hosting / residency: our production traffic will be in us-east-1.
- PHI: yes, limited PHI will be exchanged (patient identifiers and short clinical notes). Expected peak ~120 QPS, average ~15 QPS during business hours.
- Retention: current preference is 30 days for request/response logs with an option for 90-day archival if needed.
- Evidence lead: myself (Olivia Chen, olivia.chen@nimblecare.com) and our security mailbox (security@nimblecare.com).
- Timeline: we're targeting security sign-off by end of Q4 2026 and production early Q1 2027.

We attached our org profile to help with the prefill. Kickoff works for Tue Aug 24 at 10:00 PT for our security and engineering leads.

Thanks — I look forward to the prefilled CAIQ and the evidence matrix.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Director of Product & Integrations
NimbleCare
olivia.chen@nimblecare.com

Subject: Re: NimbleCare: SIG kickoff and scoped evidence matrix (post-demo clarifications)

Thanks Olivia — helpful answers. A couple of quick technical clarifications from the SE side so we can scope evidentiary owners correctly: 

1) When you say "short clinical notes," can you confirm whether full free-text clinical notes (long form) will be sent, or only structured fields + brief snippets? If long-form clinical text will be sent, we'll treat that as PHI by default and recommend Private/Dedicated deployment.
2) For encryption at rest, do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK) or is provider-managed KMS acceptable for initial onboarding?
3) Tokenization/pseudonymization: will you require tokenization on our side or do you plan to pseudonymize before sending?
4) Retention: are the 30/90 day windows for logs only, or do they include any stored embeddings or model outputs?

If you prefer, we can prefill the SIG/CAIQ to indicate current controls and mark items that require additional evidence (BAA, SOC 2 report, encryption key policy, dataflow diagrams). Marcus — I'll prepare a short tech note that maps which evidence artifacts we can provide, and which will need NimbleCare inputs.

Avery Johnson
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai
